potion.name: Honey Tonic
potion.text: Heals four tenths of your HP. Drink it in a fight; it takes your turn.

mana-potion.name: Moon Dew
mana-potion.text: Gives back half your mana. Drink it in a fight; it takes your turn.

reroll.name: Do-Over
reroll.text: Roll the die again before you walk.

minus-one.name: Hold
minus-one.text: Hold back one step, never below one.

exact.name: Fairy Pick
exact.text: The fairy picks the number you ask for: walk exactly that.
